label: Readwise Reader Document
description: A document in Readwise Reader — an article, email, feed item, PDF, video or podcast saved to the read-later library. One row per Reader document id; mirrors Reader's `/api/v3/list/` payload for upstream fidelity. Distinct from `readwise.book`, which is the Highlights product's v2 source object.

summary.description: Short description of the document, usually the source's own excerpt (maps to Reader `summary`).

category.description: What kind of document this is (maps to Reader `category`). Reader assigns one from the source URL when a save does not name it.

location.description: Which Reader triage bucket the document sits in (maps to Reader `location`). Only `new`, `later`, `archive` and `feed` can be written; `shortlist` is readable but a write naming it is silently stored as `new`.

reader_url.description: Deep link to the document in Reader (maps to Reader `url`). Assigned by Reader, not by the saver, so it is absent until the document exists upstream.

source_url.description: URL of the original content (maps to Reader `source_url`). Reader deduplicates saves on this value, which makes it the natural key for a create.

site_name.description: Publication or site the document came from (maps to Reader `site_name`).

readwise_source.description: How the document entered Reader — e.g. `Reader RSS`, `reader-mobile-app`, `api` (maps to Reader `source`). Field-renamed to avoid shadowing the first-class `source` column on the items table.

word_count.description: Word count of the extracted text, where Reader computed one.

reading_time.description: Human-readable estimated reading time, e.g. `4 mins` (maps to Reader `reading_time`). A string upstream, not a number.

listening_time.description: Human-readable estimated listening time for audio documents (maps to Reader `listening_time`).

reading_progress.description: How far through the document the reader has got, from 0 to 1 (maps to Reader `reading_progress`).

published_date.description: When the original content was published (maps to Reader `published_date`). Reader returns a bare calendar date and accepts a full instant on write, so both shapes are allowed.

image_url.description: Cover or hero image for the document (maps to Reader `image_url`).

notes.description: The reader's own note on the document as a whole (maps to Reader `notes`). Distinct from notes attached to individual highlights, which the v3 API cannot write.

tags.description: Tag names applied to the document. Reader reads tags back as an object keyed by name and takes a plain list on write; this holds the normalized list of names.

saved_at.description: When the document was saved to Reader (maps to Reader `saved_at`).

updated.description: When the document last changed upstream (maps to Reader `updated_at`). Field-renamed to avoid shadowing the first-class `updated_at` column on the items table.

last_moved_at.description: When the document last changed triage bucket (maps to Reader `last_moved_at`).

first_opened_at.description: When the document was first opened in Reader (maps to Reader `first_opened_at`).

last_opened_at.description: When the document was last opened in Reader (maps to Reader `last_opened_at`).
